name: gaps3-agenda-cards
description: audit-gaps-3 (switch TI4_VOTE_CHECK). Base pbd72@802: Minister of Policy (Elect Player) after every vote (muaat 1 for Muaat, arborec 2 for Arborec, winnu 1 for Winnu; Arborec is elected), the shenanigans window. Confusing Legal Text ("When you are elected as the outcome of an agenda") played by winnu, who is not elected, is refused (the original accepted any agenda-phase play). Bribery ("After the speaker votes on an agenda: Spend any number of trade goods. For each trade good spent, cast 1 additional vote for the outcome on which you voted."): muaat spends 2 trade goods, Muaat now has 3 votes and wins. Confounding Legal Text ("When another player is elected as the outcome of an agenda: You are the elected player instead.") by winnu: resolving the agenda for Muaat is refused, for Winnu it resolves.
